{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_id_counts = data['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicate_patients = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1].index

# Print the number of duplicate patient IDs and the highest sample_seq for each
print(f"Number of duplicate patient IDs: {len(duplicate_patients)}")
print(f"Duplicate patient IDs: {list(duplicate_patients)}")

# Check the sample_seq for each duplicate patient
for pid in duplicate_patients:
    patient_rows = data[data['patient_id'] == pid]
    print(f"Patient {pid} has sample_seq values: {sorted(patient_rows['sample_seq'].unique())}")"}
